mentions.name: Lighthouse
mentions.description: A personal shipment-tracking PWA called Lighthouse that consolidates all shipments into a single UI instead of searching through mailboxes or multiple merchant apps/sites. An LLM processes carrier update emails, with everything manually adjustable or creatable from scratch. It tracks multiple delivery destinations (work, home, pick-up spots), showing pickup locations and pickup codes, offers real-time sync so household members see updates immediately, feels native on mobile with animations, and runs at $0 cost.
mentions.problem: Shipment information is scattered across email mailboxes and several merchant apps/sites.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just a little personal tool: Shipment tracking I call Lighthouse:

- All our shipments in one UI (instead of searching trough our mail boxes or going to several merchant apps/sites)
